qualification: The minimum educational qualification for both Havildar and Naib Subedar (Sports) posts is Matriculation (Class 10th) from a recognized School/Board/University.

selection_process: Applications are received only through Registered or normal post. || Shortlisting is done based on higher sports achievements of the candidate. || Call-up letters are sent to shortlisted candidates via email, indicating date, time and place of selection trials. || Candidates undergo Physical Fitness Test, Physical Standards Test, and Skill Test at the designated Army Centre. || Candidates qualifying the above tests undergo medical examination at the trial site itself. || Candidates declared Medically Temporary Unfit may avail specialist review at a Military Hospital within 21 days; no further appeal is permissible. || Candidates declared Medically Permanent Unfit may appeal for specialist opinion within 21 days on payment of Rs. 10 by Military Receivable Order (MRO); no further appeal is permissible. || The final selection list is prepared from candidates who qualify in all respects, depending on available vacancies in each sports discipline. || Selected candidates must submit a Police Verification form along with the Offer of Enrolment. || Selection is provisional until candidates report to the allotted Regimental/Corps Training Centre and complete their enrolment form.
